name: Discovery Credentials Inbound (public.event.discovery)
description: Inbound topic that LECScanningConfig CONSUMES (does not produce). Credential events from the Discovery domain — managed elsewhere — are reflected locally. Routed by the messageType header into credential commands, with a legacy protobuf fallback by EntityType.

annotations.text: Consume only — DiscoveryProcessor routes by header messageType (consumer.go:92)

nodes.text:
3 messageType (header):

• DiscoveryCredentialAck → UpdateCredentialAckCommand → actualiza VaultStatus de la credential local

• ShareDiscoveryCredential → AddShareCredentialCommand (por credential) → crea credenciales compartidas localmente

• CredentialVaultReference → UpsertCredentialReferenceCommand (upsert) o DeleteCredentialCommand (delete) → gestiona vaultReference (vault_id, vault_name, vault_type)

Legacy fallback (sin header messageType):
parsea discoveryProto.EdgeInboundMessage (protobuf) y rutea por EntityType:
• CredentialAcknowledgement → UpdateCredentialAckCommand
• SharedCredentials → AddShareCredentialCommand

Wiring: env KAFKA_EVENT_TOPIC (default public.event.discovery.stag en staging) · DiscoveryProcessor · proto v1+v2 coexisten.

Migración Postgres — toca solo Credential:
• VaultStatus → child table credential_vault_statuses
• VaultReference → flattened (vault_id, vault_name, vault_type)
• creación de credentials (+ M:M vía credential_components)
